svg.title: Emre Kalem arm - ArUco DICT_4X4_50 marker print sheet (A4, print at 100%)
svg.text: FactoryLM / Emre Kalem arm - fiducial marker sheet
ArUco DICT_4X4_50 - 13 stickers - quiet zone 1 module (already inside every white square)
Generated by Software/arm-vision/make_marker_sheet.py from Software/vision/markers.csv. Do not edit this SVG by hand.
100 mm - MEASURE THIS BEFORE CUTTING ANYTHING
If this line is not exactly 100 mm, the printer rescaled the page.
Reprint at Actual Size / 100% / Scale: None. Do NOT use Fit to Page.
BASE-1 id0 36mm
BASE-2 id1 36mm
HAND-1 id9 25mm
TURRET-1 id2 20mm
TURRET-2 id3 20mm
SHOULDER-1 id4 17mm
ELBOW-1 id6 13mm
WRIST-1 id8 11mm
SHOULDER-2 id5 8mm
HAND-2 id10 8mm
ELBOW-2 id7 6mm
FINGER-A id11 6mm
FINGER-B id12 6mm
BEFORE YOU CUT
1. Print at Actual Size / 100%. Check the 100 mm rule above with a steel rule. Everything on this sheet is wrong if that fails.
2. Cut on the grey dashed line. The white ring between the line and the marker is SPARE quiet zone - keeping it is free and helps detection.
3. Never write, stamp or stick anything inside the white square. Ink in the quiet zone breaks detection. The printed label is deliberately outside it.
4. The arrow on each label is UP. Apply the sticker that way up every time - a re-applied sticker at a different rotation silently flips the residual sign.
5. The number on the label (e.g. 36mm) is the BLACK SQUARE edge. That is the value you pass to cv2.aruco / solvePnP as the marker length -
NOT the size of the white square you cut out, and NOT the size of the paper card.
6. Matte paper or matte label stock. A gloss finish specular-highlights under the bench lamp and blinds the detector at exactly the angles you care about.
7. Stick each marker only where docs/marker_placement_diagram.svg says. Several faces that look ideal are inner channel walls you cannot reach.
WHAT THIS SHEET IS NOT: a measurement. These are blanks. A sticker yields a CHANGE in orientation, not a joint angle, until the two
calibration passes in Documentation/MARKER-SYSTEM.md section 6 have been run. Detection grades are on the placement diagram, not here:
a grade depends on the camera standoff and on an UNVERIFIED focal length, and a number that can be wrong should not look authoritative.
Sources: Software/vision/markers.csv - Software/vision/stl-face-survey.csv - Documentation/MARKER-SYSTEM.md
